messages:
Maya: quick account-health ping — errors up 3.2% WoW, deep-dive shows 5xx + timeout mix this morning. top offenders: /v1/generate (model=v2-large) -> 5xx spike, /v1/embeddings/batch -> timeouts at 95th pctl, and /v1/route:predict -> rate_limit for a handful of high-throughput customers. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/accounts/AC-183/errors (links to alert board)
Jordan: thanks — do we have an approximate customer impact list? Are these new regressions or recurring?
Maya: early look — 5 customers >50% of the routed failures for /v1/generate; two are on dedicated capacity (AC-183, AC-221). The /embeddings timeouts correlate with large batch requests from a single client (AC-199) hitting sequence length >4k.
AlertBot: [ALERT] 5xx-rate exceeded threshold for /v1/generate at 2026-03-20T08:12:03Z (window: 15m). Current rate: 4.6% (threshold 2.0%).
Sandeep: linking traces now. probably a memory pressure/kv-cache eviction pattern on the v2-large shard. I'll check pod OOM / gc logs.
Jordan: can we mitigate quickly? fallback to v2-medium for AC-183 while we triage?
Maya: agree — suggest temporary fallback and rate-limiting backpressure for heavy embedding batches. @EngOncall can you handle the routing tweak for AC-183? (no config change on customer side)
EngOncall: on it — will push a routing policy to divert AC-183 -> v2-medium (canary) and add a 10% token-limit throttle for embeddings on AC-199. ETA 12m.
Lina: FYI finance flagged spend delta for AC-183 yesterday — if we shift model variant we should note expected latency/cost impact for the account team.
Maya: noted. I'll add a customer note and loop AE. Also creating a short impact summary for renewals team.
Sandeep: pulled the traces: kv cache miss rate jumps at the same time as 5xx and we see increased kernel-level context switches. Suspect a new kernel op in the latest runtime build. Rollback candidate is r2026.03.18.2.
Jordan: do we have a canary rollback window? if rollback reduces errors, we schedule controlled upgrade later.
EngOncall: canary rollback queued for v2-large pool r2026.03.18.2 -> rolling restart across 6 nodes. Starting now.
AlertBot: [INFO] Routing policy applied: AC-183 -> v2-medium (canary) by EngOncall at 2026-03-20T08:27:40Z.
Maya: quick checks: after routing change 5xx for AC-183 dropped to 0.9% in the last 5m. embeddings timeouts for AC-199 down after throttle. remaining 5xx are across other tenants; Sandeep, can you confirm post-rollback traces?
Sandeep: rollback reduced CPU spikes and cache churn. still seeing a small number of 5xx from an old client hitting /v1/route:predict with extremely high QPS — looks like windows of >600 rps. request pattern causing token-level throttles to trip.
Jordan: ok let's add an automated doc on safe QPS for /v1/route:predict and notify top 5 customers. Maya, can you own comms? I'll draft technical note for devs.
Maya: will do. Action items: 1) Maya: send customer comms + renewals note (by EOD). 2) EngOncall: confirm full rollback status and monitor for 2 hours. 3) Sandeep: deeper root-cause on runtime op (logs + kernel build) and PR rollback plan. 4) Jordan: prepare short runbook for embedding batch throttles.
Lina: adding FYI to AC-183 renewal playbook: note for AE re: observed errors and mitigation.
EngOncall: rollback complete; monitoring window open. I'll post status in 30m. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks team. if errors creep back, escalate to incident channel. otherwise we'll include this in next weekly account-health summary.
Jordan: thanks — good quick ops. :raised_hands:
